'''Cara''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. At some point she defected from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and became part of the [[Order of Revan]], joining with the Revanite forces on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] and becoming a walker pilot in the [[Sword Squadron (Revanites)|Sword Squadron]]. She and a fellow Revanite [[Lex (Revanite)|Lex]] were trying to stop a [[Yavin Coalition]] strike team from reaching the [[Temple of Sacrifice]], but were unsuccessful and were destroyed along with their walkers.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cara appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].
